source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.
support.issue: names Narbash, who is not in this lane's matchup list; Phase is the third losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane; stay beside your carry and answer their engage instead of throwing Web Lash first.

support.quote: Play for the pick: Glacial Charge in, Hoarfrost to root, Boreal Sweep to slow, then Cryoseism while they're held. Once Raiment of Renewal is done around minute 18, stay in front longer and peel divers off your carry with Hoarfrost.
support.issue: jargon 'peel' a new player won't know
support.rewrite: Play for the pick: Glacial Charge in, Hoarfrost to root, Boreal Sweep to slow, then Cryoseism while they're held. Once Raiment of Renewal is done around minute 18, stay in front longer and root enemies who jump your carry with Hoarfrost.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.
support.issue: names Narbash, who is not in this lane's matchup list; Phase is the third losing matchup
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Phase beat this lane; let them engage first and answer with Cursed Edge instead of leaping in.

support.quote: Channeling Black Hole leaves you open; if divers still have their engage ready, hold it and peel for your carry instead.
support.issue: jargon 'peel' a new player won't know
support.rewrite: Channeling Black Hole leaves you open; if divers still have their engage ready, hold it and stay beside your carry to protect them instead.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.
support.issue: Narbash is not in this lane's matchup list, and Phase (a 'theirs' verdict) is left out
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this lane on our read; stay behind your carry and save Maco Strike! to stop their engage.

offlane.quote: Poke with Maco Gift! and keep moving to build Mach Speed!, then throw Maco Sparkle! from long range and follow with Maco Fly! for the slow and shield. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done by minute 16, start those trades yourself.
offlane.issue: tells the player to start trades in a lane where every listed offlaner is a 'theirs' verdict, contradicting line 2
offlane.rewrite: Poke with Maco Gift! and keep moving to build Mach Speed!, then throw Maco Sparkle! from long range and follow with Maco Fly! for the slow and shield. Once Combustion and Wraith Leggings are done by minute 16, look for fights alongside your jungler instead of trading alone.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Narbash win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.
support.issue: Narbash is not in this lane's matchup list, and Phase (a 'theirs' verdict) is left out
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker, Mourn and Phase win this lane on our read; don't charge Serenity in the open, stay behind your carry with Alacrity ready.

jungle.quote: Gank by charging Wild Rush from out of sight, then Highland Hurl to slow and Ruthless Assault to stack Hersir. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, use Unstoppable Force to cleanse their stuns and roots and dive under enemy towers.
jungle.issue: misleading: you cannot cast Unstoppable Force while stunned; its tower disable is what makes the dive safe
jungle.rewrite: Gank by charging Wild Rush from out of sight, then Highland Hurl to slow and Ruthless Assault to stack Hersir. After Viper and Deathstalker by minute 16, use Unstoppable Force to cleanse slows and disable enemy towers before you dive under them.

support.quote: Riktor, Dekker and Narbash win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.
support.issue: names Narbash, who is not in this lane's matchup list; Phase (theirs) is omitted
support.rewrite: Riktor, Dekker and Phase win this lane, so stop starting trades against them and stay behind your carry until your jungler arrives.
